what: Micron is one of the three big memory-chip makers: DRAM (working memory) and NAND (storage). High-bandwidth memory (HBM), which sits next to AI GPUs, is its key growth product.
customers: Server makers and cloud providers, NVIDIA (for HBM), and phone, PC and car makers.
money: memory for servers, PCs, phones and HBM for AI
SSD storage for data centers and devices
moat: Memory has only three major players and entry takes tens of billions of dollars and deep know-how. Micron is the only large US maker.
risks: Memory is highly cyclical; prices collapse when supply runs ahead
HBM competition with SK Hynix and Samsung
